title: Hover Rancher Soundtrack
description: The downloadable Hover Rancher soundtrack, available on Steam. The base game is not included.

title: Hover Rancher
description: Pilot your hovercraft across a wild, untamed world in Hover Rancher—a point-and-click adventure packed with action minigames like aerial dogfights and snowboarding! Explore, collect, and deploy troops as you build your ranching empire from the skies.

title: Squirrel Idle Tycoon
description: Squirrel Idle Tycoon is a cozy, addictive idle game where you grow a squirrel-powered ice and water business into a thriving empire. Gather resources, hire hardworking squirrels, unlock powerful upgrades, and earn passive income even while you’re offline.

title: Emu Empire
description: Build your empire, manage resources, and ascend to greatness in Emu Empire—a quirky strategy game where every decision shapes your legacy!

title: Dillingham
description: Dillingham is a fast-paced fish-processing and logistics simulator where chaos meets precision. Run an Alaskan seafood plant, unload boats, sort and process fish, manage conveyor systems, operate forklifts, and keep every station flowing before the whole line backs up.

title: Goat Nuclear Clicker
description: An absurd incremental clicker — click goats, trigger nuclear chaos, automate production, and ascend through galaxies in a multiverse of upgrades and detonation-driven mayhem.

title: A Rocket's Intensity
description: Experience high-speed battles across various environments in this action-packed game. Use rockets to take down enemy UFOs and conquer multiple challenging levels. Upgrade your ship and unlock powerful weapons to dominate the skies and emerge victorious in this epic war.

title: The Paper Arcade
description: The Paper Arcade is a collection of classic arcade-style games with a unique drawing and sketchbook aesthetic. Enjoy fast-paced, high-score chasing action, challenging puzzles, and casual games. Each game is brought to life with stunning hand-drawn graphics. Addictive, retro-style gaming fun!

title: The Paper Arcade Soundtrack
description: Soundtrack for The Paper Arcade

title: The Paper Arcade - Maze Chase
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. Expand your maze-running adventures with the new Maze Chase DLC! Get ready to face new challenges and obstacles as you navigate through even more complex mazes. With additional levels and game modes, Maze Chase DLC offers hours of fun gameplay for both new and experienced players.

title: The Paper Arcade - Bombs A'hoy
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. But be careful! One wrong move could send you flying, leaving you vulnerable to enemy attacks and explosions. And as you progress through the game, the obstacles and enemies will become more challenging, requiring even more strategic thinking and quick reflexes to overcome.

title: The Paper Arcade - MindField Master
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. But be careful! One wrong move could set off a chain reaction of explosions, ending the game in a fiery blast. As you progress through the game, the minefield will become larger and more complex, requiring even more precision and strategic thinking to navigate.

title: The Paper Arcade - Paper Bird
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. Welcome to "Paper Arcade: Flying Bird Edition"! Get ready to take flight with this addictive and challenging game, perfect for players of all ages.

title: The Paper Arcade - Snake
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. In this game, you will control a cute little paper snake and guide it through a vibrant world of paper mazes and obstacles.

title: The Paper Arcade - Poker
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. Welcome to "Paper Arcade: Poker Edition"! Get ready to experience the thrill and excitement of one of the world's most beloved card games, right from the comfort of your own home.

title: The Paper Arcade - Pinball
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. Welcome to "Paper Arcade: Pinball Edition"! Get ready to experience the thrill and excitement of one of the world's most beloved arcade games, right from the comfort of your own home.

title: The Paper Arcade: Singing Sparrow
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. Welcome to "Paper Arcade: Singing Sparrow Edition"! Get ready to flap your wings and test your reflexes in this addictive game of skill and timing.

title: The Paper Arcade: Kingdom Kitty
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. Welcome to "Paper Arcade: Match-3 RPG Edition"! Get ready to embark on an epic adventure filled with magical gems, powerful spells, and thrilling battles.

title: Avalanca
description: Carve curved mountain trails, catch cliffside air and outrun avalanches and Drunk Yeti. Explore seven destinations, conquer six Tours and unlock riders in this hand-drawn arcade adventure, with solo, local multiplayer and a Steam online race preview.

title: Avalanca - Mythos
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. Explore the mysteries of Odonis Orphane in the bonus DLC for Avalanca. Equip cutting-edge weaponry, face new alien threats, and unlock extraterrestrial powers. The cosmos awaits – are you ready for the alien odyssey?

title: Avalanca - Divinity: Belfy Bastion
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. Dive into the enchanting realm of Avalanca once again with the thrilling DLC expansion, Belfry Bastion. This immersive tower defense game seamlessly blends the captivating characters and lore of Avalanca with strategic gameplay, offering players a fresh experience within the beloved universe.

title: Xero: From Xéro To Xēro
description: Welcome to the adrenaline-fueled world of Xero, a high-octane platform game that thrusts you into the cockpit of a futuristic fighting robot! Strap on your jetpack, power up your lasers, and unsheathe your razor-sharp swords as you prepare for the ultimate battle.

title: AR3NA
description: AR3NA is a top-down battle arena game that blends fast-paced action with strategic gameplay. Engage in heart-pounding battles against epic foes as you fight for supremacy in a variety of dynamic arenas. Use your wit, reflexes, and cunning tactics to outmaneuver your opponents and emerge victorious.

title: Arena (Gameboy Edition)
description: DLC; requires the base game on Steam. Step into the pixelated realm of nostalgia with the AR3NA: Gameboy Classic Edition DLC! This remastered version takes you back to the roots of the original AR3NA, featuring 100 challenging levels that will test your precision and gaming prowess.

title: MANA
description: Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of MANA, where strategic brilliance combines with explosive visuals! Engage in intense battles, using angles to unleash a dazzling array of shapes and colors. MANA reinvents strategic warfare with a visually stunning and uniquely dynamic twist.

title: The Paper Arcade: Pong
description: The Paper Arcade: Pong is a hand-drawn twist on the arcade classic! With soccer-inspired visuals, magnetic chaos, and multiball power-ups, it's pong like you've never seen. Play 1v1 or add up to 6 AI players for frantic free-for-alls and sketchy team battles.

title: Space Pinball
description: Blast off into a cosmic twist on classic pinball! In Space Pinball, you're a UFO racking up points by crashing into asteroids while navigating an ever-changing playfield. Survive with just three lives as the stars—and the arena—fall around you.

title: Klay Karts
description: Race clay karts through sculpted circuits, build ramps and turn wet tire tracks into boosts.

title: PenPals: Battle for the Blank
description: Draw loops, bridges and other solutions in an art-themed arena campaign and the Graphite Garden chapter.

title: Yeti Brawl
description: Fight across platform arenas with seven fighter kits, CPU rivals, local versus and local co-op.
